mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_document (pet_id, doc_name, doc_type, file_url, issued_date) VALUES (#{petId}, #{docName}, #{docType}, #{fileUrl}, #{issuedDate})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pet_document WHERE pet_id = #{petId} AND doc_type = #{docType} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM pet_document WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND pet_id = #{petId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pet_document WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND pet_id = #{petId}
